#  | Realm Bot Docs

> Official Realm Bot documentation for managing Minecraft Bedrock Realms through Discord-setup guides, modules, security tools, and integrations.

- [Welcome to Realm Bot Documentation](https://shadowsniper784.github.io/readme.md): Welcome to Realm Bot Documentation
- [Getting Started](https://shadowsniper784.github.io/setup.md): Connect your Minecraft Bedrock Realm to Discord in three steps. Link your Microsoft account, run the connect command, then configure modules and settings.
- [Commands](https://shadowsniper784.github.io/commands/index.md): Use Realm Bot's Discord slash commands to manage connected Minecraft Bedrock Realms, players, activity, and live Relay features.

## Server Dashboard

- [Server Dashboard](https://shadowsniper784.github.io/server-dashboard/overview.md): Understand the Server Dashboard overview, including Premium status, linked account details, connected Realms, and where to configure server-wide settings.
- [Server Setup](https://shadowsniper784.github.io/server-dashboard/server-setup.md): Complete the recommended setup checklist for your Discord server, including logging, permissions, warn presets, and account linking.
- [Log Channels](https://shadowsniper784.github.io/server-dashboard/server-logs.md): Configure which Discord channels receive Realm Bot moderation logs, including bans, unbans, kicks, and warnings.
- [Account Linking](https://shadowsniper784.github.io/server-dashboard/server-account-linking.md): Configure how members link their Minecraft account to Discord, including automatic role assignment, optional nickname syncing, auto-invites to selected Realms, and join log reporting.
- [Message Actions](https://shadowsniper784.github.io/server-dashboard/server-message-actions.md): Configure the automated moderation messages sent to players when actions are taken, using variables to keep messages consistent, informative, and compliant.
- [Warn Settings](https://shadowsniper784.github.io/server-dashboard/server-warnings.md): Configure warning types with custom reasons and thresholds, allowing consistent moderation and automatic escalation based on the number of warnings issued.
- [Command Settings](https://shadowsniper784.github.io/server-dashboard/server-command-settings.md): Control how Realm Bot displays player information in commands, including a compact view or a more detailed output for moderation and auditing.
- [Permissions](https://shadowsniper784.github.io/server-dashboard/server-permissions.md): Control which Discord roles can use specific Realm Bot commands by assigning granular permissions per role.
- [Allowlist](https://shadowsniper784.github.io/server-dashboard/server-allowlist.md): Maintain an allowlist of trusted users who can bypass automated enforcement systems such as Member Gate, Bot Detection, and Skin Filtering.
- [Moderation Logs](https://shadowsniper784.github.io/server-dashboard/server-mod-logs.md): Review and audit moderation actions taken across your connected realms, with filtering and per-user history views.
- [Invite Links](https://shadowsniper784.github.io/server-dashboard/server-invites.md): Create secure, shareable invite links (realmbot.link/...) that let players join your Minecraft Bedrock Realms through a controlled, auditable flow with optional VPN/Tor blocking.

## Realm Modules

- [Overview](https://shadowsniper784.github.io/realm-modules/overview.md): A central hub for managing your Realm connection, bot join behaviour, Gametest pack dependencies, and all available Realm Modules.
- [Chat Relay](https://shadowsniper784.github.io/realm-modules/chat-relay.md): Connect your Realm and Discord with a two-way chat bridge, including configurable message types, emote relaying, and built-in anti-spam controls.
- [Realm Console](https://shadowsniper784.github.io/realm-modules/realm-console.md): Execute Minecraft commands directly from a secured Discord channel, using your in-game Relay Account as the command runner.
- [Bot Detection](https://shadowsniper784.github.io/realm-modules/bot-detection.md): Detect and remove suspected automated accounts from connected public Realms, with optional experimental checks and automatic bans.
- [Member Gate](https://shadowsniper784.github.io/realm-modules/member-gate.md): Evaluate joining players against device, gamerscore, and social-profile rules, with private-title-history and automated entry checks.
- [Scoreboard Leaderboards](https://shadowsniper784.github.io/realm-modules/scoreboard-leaderboards.md): Publish live in-game scoreboard rankings to Discord, allowing players to track progress and compete through automated leaderboard embeds.
- [Vanity URL](https://shadowsniper784.github.io/realm-modules/vanity-url.md): Create a stable, memorable realmbot.link address that uses Realm Bot's managed Microsoft-authenticated invite flow.
- [Skin Filtering](https://shadowsniper784.github.io/realm-modules/skin-filtering.md): Automatically detect and remove players using irregular skins (small, invisible/transparent, or 4D/Horion-style skins) to improve fairness and reduce exploit abuse.
- [Leveling System](https://shadowsniper784.github.io/realm-modules/leveling-system.md): Award XP for eligible chat activity and online play, with persistent levels, rankings, leaderboards, and configurable level-up announcements.
- [Live Playerlist](https://shadowsniper784.github.io/realm-modules/live-playerlist.md): Publish an automatically updating list of online Realm players to a Discord channel, with optional playtime and device identification.
- [Relay Account and GameTest Dependencies](https://shadowsniper784.github.io/realm-modules/relay-account-and-gametest.md): Understand the shared Relay Account, GameTest Pack, Beta API, permission, and connection requirements used by Realm Bot modules.

## Realm Page

- [Realm Overview](https://shadowsniper784.github.io/realm-page/realm-overview.md): View essential Realm status, slots, settings, and recent activity from a single dashboard page, with quick access to official Realm management.
- [Realm Activity](https://shadowsniper784.github.io/realm-page/realm-activity.md): Track player sessions, total playtime, daily activity trends, peak hours, and recent sessions to understand when your Realm is active and who is playing.
- [World Management](https://shadowsniper784.github.io/realm-page/realm-world.md): Manage your Realm’s active world slot, download backups, replace worlds, and control Behaviour/Resource packs (including upload, enable/disable, and pack priority).

## Commands

### Allowlist

- [Allowlist Commands](https://shadowsniper784.github.io/commands/allowlist/index.md): Manage Realm Bot's server-level exemption list for supported automated systems.
- [/allowlist add](https://shadowsniper784.github.io/commands/allowlist/add.md): Add a Minecraft player to Realm Bot's server-level allowlist for supported automated systems.
- [/allowlist check](https://shadowsniper784.github.io/commands/allowlist/check.md): Check whether a Minecraft player is on Realm Bot's server-level allowlist.
- [/allowlist list](https://shadowsniper784.github.io/commands/allowlist/list.md): Display Realm Bot's server-level allowlist using interactive pages of ten players.
- [/allowlist remove](https://shadowsniper784.github.io/commands/allowlist/remove.md): Remove a Minecraft player from Realm Bot's server-level automation allowlist.

### Banlist

- [Banlist Commands](https://shadowsniper784.github.io/commands/banlist/index.md): Inspect official Minecraft Realm blocklists and submit players for Realm Bot Global Ban review.
- [/banlist all](https://shadowsniper784.github.io/commands/banlist/all.md): List players on a selected Minecraft Realm's official blocklist.
- [/banlist lookup](https://shadowsniper784.github.io/commands/banlist/lookup.md): Check a player's official blocklist status in one or all connected Minecraft Realms.
- [/db report](https://shadowsniper784.github.io/commands/banlist/report.md): Submit a Minecraft player and supporting evidence for Realm Bot Global Ban review.

### Player

- [Player Commands](https://shadowsniper784.github.io/commands/player/index.md): Retrieve enriched live player information or the most recent stored fallback record.
- [/player lookup](https://shadowsniper784.github.io/commands/player/lookup.md): Retrieve enriched live player details when available, with a potentially older stored fallback.

### Realm

- [Realm Commands](https://shadowsniper784.github.io/commands/realm/index.md): Manage Realm membership, moderation, configuration, player activity, world slots, codes, and backups.
- [/realm ban](https://shadowsniper784.github.io/commands/realm/ban.md): Add a player to the official blocklist of one or all connected Realms.
- [/realm unban](https://shadowsniper784.github.io/commands/realm/unban.md): Remove a player from the official blocklist of one or all connected Realms.
- [/realm kick](https://shadowsniper784.github.io/commands/realm/kick.md): Remove a player from Realm membership without adding them to the official blocklist.
- [/realm invite](https://shadowsniper784.github.io/commands/realm/invite.md): Add a resolved Minecraft player as an official member of one or all connected Realms.
- [/realm permission](https://shadowsniper784.github.io/commands/realm/permission.md): Set a player's official Realm permission to Visitor, Member, or Operator.
- [/realm open](https://shadowsniper784.github.io/commands/realm/open.md): Open one or all connected Realms to player joins.
- [/realm close](https://shadowsniper784.github.io/commands/realm/close.md): Close one or all connected Realms to new player joins.
- [/realm rename](https://shadowsniper784.github.io/commands/realm/rename.md): Change the actual Minecraft Bedrock Realm name shown to members.
- [/realm nickname](https://shadowsniper784.github.io/commands/realm/nickname.md): Change the local Realm label Realm Bot uses in Discord without renaming the Minecraft Realm.
- [/realm slot](https://shadowsniper784.github.io/commands/realm/slot.md): Switch a selected Realm to world slot 1, 2, or 3.
- [/realm code-manage](https://shadowsniper784.github.io/commands/realm/code-manage.md): Interactively create and manage official invite codes for a selected Minecraft Realm.
- [/realm players](https://shadowsniper784.github.io/commands/realm/players.md): Display official live Realm players with device and optional Realm permission information.
- [/realm members](https://shadowsniper784.github.io/commands/realm/members.md): Display official Realm members and blocked players, with currently limited filtering and search.
- [/realm recents](https://shadowsniper784.github.io/commands/realm/recents.md): Display up to 100 recently seen Xbox club members for a selected Realm.
- [/realm lastseen](https://shadowsniper784.github.io/commands/realm/lastseen.md): Search connected Realms for a player's most recent Xbox club activity record.
- [/realm playtime](https://shadowsniper784.github.io/commands/realm/playtime.md): Sum the recorded activity intervals available for a player in a selected Realm.
- [/realm sessions](https://shadowsniper784.github.io/commands/realm/sessions.md): Display a player's recorded Realm activity intervals grouped by day.
- [/realm backup-create](https://shadowsniper784.github.io/commands/realm/backup-create.md): Start a named backup request for a selected Minecraft Bedrock Realm.
- [/realm backup-list](https://shadowsniper784.github.io/commands/realm/backup-list.md): List, save, and restore automatic or manual backups for a selected Realm.

### Invites

- [Invite Commands](https://shadowsniper784.github.io/commands/invites/index.md): Create, review, and remove Realm Bot managed web invite links.
- [/invites create](https://shadowsniper784.github.io/commands/invites/create.md): Create a reusable Realm Bot managed web invite with optional usage and expiry limits.
- [/invites temp](https://shadowsniper784.github.io/commands/invites/temp.md): Create a one-use Realm Bot managed invite link that expires after 24 hours.
- [/invites list](https://shadowsniper784.github.io/commands/invites/list.md): Display the Discord server's Realm Bot managed invite-link records and usage status.
- [/invites delete](https://shadowsniper784.github.io/commands/invites/delete.md): Permanently delete a Realm Bot managed invite-link record by its slug.

### Stats

- [Stats Commands](https://shadowsniper784.github.io/commands/stats/index.md): Open the server leaderboard and generate player rank cards from Leveling System data.
- [/rank](https://shadowsniper784.github.io/commands/stats/rank.md): Generate a rank-card image from a player's stored Leveling System XP and level.
- [/leaderboard](https://shadowsniper784.github.io/commands/stats/leaderboard.md): Open the Discord server's public Realm Bot web leaderboard.

### Utility

- [Utility Commands](https://shadowsniper784.github.io/commands/utility/index.md): Connect Realm Bot, open service resources, review subscription information, and view bot status.
- [/connect](https://shadowsniper784.github.io/commands/utility/connect.md): Associate the current Discord server with the invoking member's linked Microsoft/Xbox Realm account.
- [/disconnect](https://shadowsniper784.github.io/commands/utility/disconnect.md): Clear the server's connected account association or remove its primary stored Guild record.
- [/dashboard](https://shadowsniper784.github.io/commands/utility/dashboard.md): Open Realm Bot Dashboard, account, and current-server management links.
- [/help](https://shadowsniper784.github.io/commands/utility/help.md): Open Realm Bot's support server, website, and documentation.
- [/invite](https://shadowsniper784.github.io/commands/utility/invite.md): Open the Realm Bot invitation and support-server links.
- [/premium](https://shadowsniper784.github.io/commands/utility/premium.md): Open Realm Bot's subscription information and Premium management page.
- [/botinfo](https://shadowsniper784.github.io/commands/utility/botinfo.md): Display Realm Bot's global, cluster, connection, uptime, and aggregate service statistics.

### Verify

- [Verify Commands](https://shadowsniper784.github.io/commands/verify/index.md): Publish Realm Bot's Microsoft/Xbox account-linking panel for Discord members.
- [/verify embed](https://shadowsniper784.github.io/commands/verify/embed.md): Post Realm Bot's Microsoft/Xbox account-linking panel in the current Discord channel.

### Warn

- [Warn Commands](https://shadowsniper784.github.io/commands/warn/index.md): Create and review Realm Bot player warning records and configured threshold actions.
- [/warn add](https://shadowsniper784.github.io/commands/warn/add.md): Record a player warning and evaluate the configured count threshold for Realm enforcement.
- [/warn lookup](https://shadowsniper784.github.io/commands/warn/lookup.md): Review a player's Realm Bot warning and warning-removal history.
- [/warn remove](https://shadowsniper784.github.io/commands/warn/remove.md): Record a warning-removal event for a player and selected Realm scope.

### World

- [World Commands](https://shadowsniper784.github.io/commands/world/index.md): Connect or disconnect the live Relay Account and perform privileged in-game actions.
- [/world join](https://shadowsniper784.github.io/commands/world/join.md): Enable persistent Relay joining and request a live connection to one or all connected Realms.
- [/world leave](https://shadowsniper784.github.io/commands/world/leave.md): Disable persistent joining and disconnect the Relay Account from one or all selected Realms.
- [/world broadcast](https://shadowsniper784.github.io/commands/world/broadcast.md): Send a prefixed announcement to in-game chat through the active Relay Account.
- [/world execute](https://shadowsniper784.github.io/commands/world/execute.md): Execute a Minecraft command through the active Relay Account with its in-game authority.
- [Command Troubleshooting](https://shadowsniper784.github.io/commands/troubleshooting.md): Resolve common Realm Bot slash-command permission, connection, Premium, Relay Account, GameTest, and input errors.

## Tools

- [Embed Panel](https://shadowsniper784.github.io/tools/embed-panel.md): Create a persistent Discord embed with up to five link or Realm-action buttons.

## Integrations

- [Tebex](https://shadowsniper784.github.io/integrations/tebex.md): Connect Tebex to deliver purchased ranks, perks, and other in-game rewards through a Realm Bot Relay Account.

## Troubleshooting

- [Automod kicked me for “Private Title History”](https://shadowsniper784.github.io/troubleshooting/private-title-history.md): Fix kicks caused by private Xbox title history by setting “Others can see your game and app history” to Everybody.
